title: DAY 19/90
GYROSCOPE
scenes.sub: Governors, balancing and the spinning top
scenes.voice: Day nineteen of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, eighty nine days to go! Week four starts with governors, balancing and the gyroscope.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is theory of machines. Our topic: governors, balancing of rotating and reciprocating masses, and the gyroscope.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover Watt, Porter and Hartnell governors, sensitiveness, stability and hunting, balancing of rotating and reciprocating masses, and the gyroscopic couple.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Gyroscopic couple equals moment of inertia, times spin speed, times precession speed. Convert both speeds to radians per second first.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Grab the free practice PDF on Telegram and work through it. Tonight's test runs seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 18 Toppers
scenes.voice: Week three test toppers! Marndi takes rank one with fourteen point six seven. Kunal is close behind at rank two, and Saumitra Raj Trivedi takes rank three. Well done!
